tools.name: Three.js
tools.use: Interactive browser asset and scene inspection
tools.note: Already in EcoVibes; standalone hub's concept garage still needs a reviewed React port.

tools.name: Blender
tools.use: Create original cars, environments, rigs and animations
tools.note: Commercial artwork is permitted. Distributed Blender modifications/add-ons need their own licence review.

tools.name: Poly Haven assets
tools.use: HDR lighting, textures and reference production assets
tools.note: Record each exact asset, source, licence and checksum. Website/API terms are separate; no bulk ingestion enabled.

tools.name: glTF Transform
tools.note: Validate meshes and texture budgets before importing into games; not installed by this milestone.

tools.name: KTX-Software
tools.note: Contains an explicitly non-open-source ETC decoder option. Review exact components and disable that option before adoption.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.use: Real browser journeys, screenshots and failure checks
tools.note: Desktop browser emulation does not prove low-end phone or controller performance.

tools.name: Open 3D Engine
tools.note: Third-party licences, hardware, target platforms and maintenance cost require evaluation. No engine replacement approved here.

tools.name: Nakama
tools.note: Server operation has real resource costs. Reuse EcoVibes identity; no duplicate account system or new service now.
